supporting_observations.claim: The periodic HTTPS activity is visible in the alert window: proxy CONNECT records target updates.pixelforge-suite.com at 13:37, 13:42, 13:47, 13:53, 13:58, 14:02, and 14:07 UTC. The 13:42 attempt received 407; the other cited attempts returned 200.

Endpoint network telemetry attributes the updater connections to C:\Program Files\PixelForge\pfupdater.exe, running as leo.martins, and shows them going to the explicit proxy. This matches the inventory's approved PixelForge updater and its approximately five-minute update checks.

Alert-window process, endpoint network, and proxy records are present and correlate the repeated connections with the approved updater and its approved update host, rather than merely showing no suspicious activity. The evidence therefore supports the legitimate updater explanation for the alerted pattern.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show HTTPS CONNECT destinations and tunnel metadata, not the contents of the encrypted TLS sessions.
The supplied records do not include a signature or hash verification for the PixelForge updater binary.
claims_not_established: The records do not establish the contents of the updater's encrypted traffic or independently verify the updater binary's integrity.
unrelated_findings: A network log records sam.okafor credentials used in a logon to WS-SOKAFOR-01 originating from WS-LMARTINS-01; this is separate from the alerted updater traffic and merits review against the remote-administration practice. (T046-00023, T046-00024)

FILE-NWD-01 is recorded connecting to WS-LMARTINS-01 on RPC port 135. The supplied records do not establish the purpose of that connection; review separately against the workstation-patching practice. (T046-00067, T046-00068, T046-00069)

DropboxUpdate.exe ran as SYSTEM, although Dropbox is not among the approved services in the inventory. The evidence does not establish a Dropbox data-transfer connection; investigate separately. (T046-00119, T046-00120)

A local-service DNS query for x7k9m2.akamaized.net returned an address, but the supplied records do not link it to the alerted PixelForge updater connections. Review separately if warranted. (T046-00124, T046-00126)
